policy: Preserve production source and notebook cell sources; retain data only with identified publisher terms and attribution; enumerate data-only omissions and cleared notebook outputs. This is not an exact full-tree import.

groups.basis: The publisher licenses basic river maps without 3- or 15-arcsecond grids under CC BY 4.0. This archive has a 6-arcminute map and 1-arcminute auxiliary grids. The embedded Fortran/scripts retain their Apache notices.
groups.attribution: CaMa-Flood basic river map, Dai Yamazaki and contributors, University of Tokyo; Yamazaki et al. (2011, 2013, 2019).
groups.modifications: None relative to the pinned upstream blob.

groups.basis: The ERA5-Land catalogue identifies the CC-BY licence. The source NetCDF identifies ECMWF and records a 2026-05-19 conversion, after the announced 2025-07-02 licence change. The paired file is the upstream CaMa-Flood conversion.
groups.attribution: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S), ECMWF: ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present, DOI 10.24381/cds.e2161bac. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (2000); upstream processing in 2026.
groups.modifications: Upstream selected Japan and January 2000 and converted runoff into CaMa-Flood forcing; ScienceAccelBench preserves both blobs unchanged. Neither the European Commission nor ECMWF is responsible for use of this information.

groups.basis: The archive combines ERA5 runoff, GTSM sea-level output and a model restart. The GTSM file has no global provenance/licence attributes. General ERA5 terms do not establish rights to the other two files.
groups.effect: The official sea-level example needs this archive from a separately authorised upstream checkout.

groups.basis: The gauge headers identify out_ori/outflw files, and the extraction script turns model output into the CSV. These are model-generated series, not established observation records. The upstream code licence does not establish a separate sample-data grant.
groups.effect: The inflow workflow can regenerate these from a licensed model run; the source script remains.

groups.basis: The upstream README explicitly calls all sample observation data dummy because actual observations cannot be redistributed. This corrects the earlier review interpretation, but supplies no explicit data licence; this submission conservatively omits the three output tables.
groups.effect: The plotting/validation scripts remain; users provide their own licensed inputs and generated output.

groups.basis: The table includes GRanD-labelled area/capacity and named dam records. No specific database version or redistribution grant accompanies this output; terms for a newer GDW/HydroATLAS product cannot license this older table by inference.
groups.effect: The dam preprocessing source remains; this diagnostic output is not a compile dependency.

other_assets.documentation: Retained upstream manuals and PNG figures as project documentation under the root Apache licence; no embedded dataset objects found in the DOCX files.
other_assets.notebook: GTSM preprocessing notebook retained with stored outputs and execution counts cleared. All cell sources and metadata remain identical to upstream; the audit checks this against the original upstream Git blob.
other_assets.configuration: Retained dimensions, grid descriptors, runoff-info text and namelist fixtures. These are configuration/schema material, not time-series input data.

curator_decision: Accepted as presented by the curator on 2026-09-06: https://github.com/aitofound/ScienceAccelBench/pull/429#issuecomment-5558275117. The accepted payload is unchanged from PR head 31bcd016b853ee27751f34bad4a64661875e64bd; omitted assets still have no established redistribution basis.

cleared_notebook_outputs.reason: Remove stored GTSM-derived tables/plots/data previews; preserve all cell sources and metadata.
